notes: (1) Literature check could not run: related_search.py got HTTP 429 from the arXiv API on two attempts, so missing references and novelty statements are knowledge-based and marked [verify]; the skill handles this but 'strict' gives no guidance for a failed network. (2) integrity_scan.py and --redact were not run because the task restricted tools to file reads/writes and the aggregation script; a manual text search found no reviewer-directed text, and reviewers read the unredacted text. (3) The skill is built around CV/ML experiments and has no clear rubric for software or library papers: the paper type 'system' fits, but the Experimental Validation and Reproducibility rubrics assume benchmark experiments, and ICLR has no tool track, so pool position was a judgment call. (4) The Phase 1.5 order (searches after the reports are drafted) conflicts with a single-pass writing workflow; I formed the reviews first and then attempted the search. (5) EIC weights: the skill says to start at 1.0 and move only for verified reasons, yet the Domain reviewer's key points rest on memory that the EIC cannot verify without the search; I kept R2 at 1.0 rather than reward or penalise it.
